title: Holding record
description: What is held, when it was last touched, and the counters a derivative can be computed from. Contacts are recorded, not judged at write time. No trajectory is ever stored here: every trajectory is computed on read, and a stored one is a judgement frozen at the moment of writing. Mirrors the stdlib validator in src/rosetta_shape_core/holding.py.

contact_log.description: Two observations minimum for a derivative, with the gap between them readable.

result.description: discrepant is the only result that carries new information; confirmed adds confidence and no content.

referent_rate.description: Not derivable from the record. Best: measured, from repeated residual contact. Usable: inherited from the domain. Default 'unknown' — and unknown must NOT silently become 'slow'. An unknown-rate holding is not a fresh one; with the rate unknown the system reports order, not magnitude.

referent_rate_days.description: Required when referent_rate is 'known' — 'known' means measured.

discrepancy_count.description: The learning counter, not the error count.

restatement_count.description: Motion in the record. High with no residual contact is circulation.

decay_class.description: Default undiagnosed. Never d1 by default: d1 is the free reading and d3 — the receiver stopped resolving a signal that never changed — is the one that costs, leaves the record untouched, and is the common case.

cross_observer_checked.description: Has another receiver been asked whether it still resolves? The only cheap discriminator for d3.
